exposure: IADPSG criteria for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis by IADPSG criteria
GDM diagnosis (IADPSG criteria vs normal glucose tolerance)
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
finding: Adopting the IADPSG criteria was associated with reduced risk of various adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, despite increased medical expenditure.
mod_finding: Adopting the IADPSG criteria was associated with a reduced risk of emergency cesarean section.
